targets.immutableContext: Lowder distinguishes a cognitive mechanism's causal origin from the separate empirical question of whether it reliably transmits information and tracks truth.

move.speaker: Jeffery Jay Lowder
move.proposition: Physical reality favors naturalism because naturalism requires it, whereas theism permits God to create disembodied minds or nothing at all.
move.sourceExcerpt: human beings but God could have also chosen to create other Minds without physical bodies such as Angels or God could have chosen to create nothing at all in other words God's existence doesn't require a physical reality so because the physical has to exist on naturalism but does not have to exist on theism it follows that the existence of physical reality is evidence favoring
